targetText: In real history, wage labour arises out of the dissolution of slavery and serfdom: or of the decay of communal property, as with oriental and Slavonic peoples, and, in its adequate, epoch-making form, the form which takes possession of the entire social being of labour, out of the decline and fall of the guild economy, of the system of Estates
explanation: Marx outlines the historical origin of wage labor: it developed from the breakdown of feudalism, serfdom, and medieval guild structures.
